about.heroBody: For 8+ years we have built websites, apps, and tools for businesses that need them to actually work — fast, secure, and built to grow. No jargon, no disappearing after launch.
about.storyBody:
Vanaila Digital started with one observation: too many businesses were forced to choose between a site that looked good and one that actually worked.

For 8+ years we've built both into the same product — and stuck around to maintain it long after launch.
about.stat2: Projects across web, app, and commerce
about.stat3: Standards we never cut: speed, security, scale
about.visionBody: A web where fast, reliable, well-built software is normal for every business — not a luxury only big companies can afford.
about.missionBody: Give growing businesses software that scales without drama — clear pricing, plain-language updates, and code they fully own.
about.pillar1Heading: We build for next year, not just launch day
about.pillar1Body: Every project is built to scale and stay easy to maintain — so you're not paying to rebuild it from scratch in 12 months.
about.pillar2Heading: We treat your project like our own
about.pillar2Body: From how it looks on a phone to how fast the database responds, the details get the same care we give our own products.
about.pillar3Body: Success is your load times, your conversion rates, and your growth — not how clever the tech looks under the hood.
about.quoteHeading: The best software disappears — your team just gets their time back, and your customers just get what they came for.
about.quoteBody: Whether you are a startup finding your footing or an established company cleaning up years of patchwork tools, we turn the messy problem into software that quietly works.
about.ctaBody: Work with a team that builds software like it has to last — because what we build, we maintain.

service.heroBody: Six ways we help your business win more customers and waste less time online — from the website people judge you by to the internal tools your team runs on. We pick the right stack for your goal, build it, and keep it fast. No templates, no bloated retainers.

items.title: Website Development
items.lede: A fast, modern site that makes the right first impression — and loads before visitors lose patience and leave.

blocks.v: React-based builds for projects that demand maximum speed and SEO. We shift work from the browser to a build step — ultra-lightweight, instantly fast.
For teams that need an intuitive CMS, we build secure, custom-themed WordPress environments — content updates without technical friction.

items.title: Custom Business Tools
items.lede: Replace the spreadsheets and manual steps eating your team's week with software built around exactly how you work.

blocks.v: React and modern JavaScript for dynamic, responsive interfaces that hold up under real-world load.
Python for secure, scalable server-side logic and clean API design — built to integrate.
We connect your app with the CRMs, databases, and automation workflows you already rely on.

items.title: Secure Online Shops
items.lede: Sell online without the headaches — checkout that converts, payments that clear, and stock that stays in sync.

blocks.v: Seamless Midtrans for the Indonesian market, Stripe for international transactions — checkout that just works.
Architectures built to handle high-traffic sales events and complex multi-channel inventory without breaking.

items.title: High-Conversion Landing Pages
items.lede: Stop burning ad budget on pages that don't convert. Built to turn paid clicks into leads you can actually close.

blocks.v: Engineered for speed so paid clicks and social traffic don't bounce before the page paints.
Structured around UX principles that lift lead generation, sign-ups, and engagement — measurable, iterable.

items.title: Mobile Business App
items.lede: Put your business in your customers' pocket — one app on both iOS and Android, at a fraction of the two-team cost.

blocks.v: React Native delivers native-like performance with the cost-efficiency of one codebase — ship once, run everywhere.
Push notifications, location services, and offline data sync — your app keeps working anywhere your users are.

items.title: Official Business Email
items.lede: Look credible from the first email. Professional addresses on your own domain, set up to land in inboxes — not spam.

blocks.v: Professional Google Workspace deployment — enterprise-grade email, cloud storage, and collaboration on yourcompany.com.
Reliable business email on your own domain, configured for high deliverability and security from day one.

trust.v: SMEs, corporates, and non-profits across industries. You're not our practice run — we've solved problems like yours before.
Midtrans, local logistics, WhatsApp-first workflows — your tools work with the providers your customers already use.
Nearly a decade building and maintaining real software. We write code you won't have to rip out and rebuild in a year.

service.productsLede: Beyond custom development, we build and maintain standalone products that solve specific business challenges out of the box.

products.title: Vanaila HRIS
products.desc: End-to-end HR management — attendance, payroll, KPI, and employee database for Indonesian organizations.

products.title: Psikotest
products.desc: Online assessment infrastructure for HR teams and psychologists. DISC, IQ, Big 5, and custom instruments with bilingual delivery.

products.title: Flowraze
products.desc: CRM & sales platform — leads, deals, campaigns, and team performance. WhatsApp-first, built for Indonesian SMB teams.

products.title: Vanaila Atelier
products.desc: Boutique design studio for brand identity, web experience, UI design, and creative direction — crafted with uncommon care.

service.templatesLede: Production-ready websites built on the Vanaila design system — with full scroll animations, design tokens, and clean React + Tailwind code. Pick a template. Own it completely.

templates.title: Design-first
templates.desc: Every template ships with the full Vanaila token set — spacing, typography, motion, colour. Not a theme. A system.

templates.title: Fully editable
templates.desc: Plain React and Tailwind. No black-box theme system. Your devs can modify everything from day one.

templates.title: Production-ready
templates.desc: Not prototypes. Each template is built and verified to perform in real deployments — fast, accessible, and maintainable.

home.promiseEyebrow: [ 03 ] What we take off your plate
home.promiseBody: Slow pages, confusing quotes, and a developer who stops replying. We've heard it all from business owners. We handle the technical side and explain every step in plain language, so you can focus on your customers.
home.servicesSubheading: Start with what your business needs today. We'll help you add more as you grow, without starting over.
home.workSubheadWithCount: A few of the {count}+ projects we've built with business owners like you.
home.workSubheadNoCount: A few of the projects we've built with business owners like you.
home.whyBody: We're a small team, and you'll talk to the people doing the work. There are no hand-offs and no fine print.
home.processBody: You'll always know what's happening, what's next, and what it costs.
home.processStep1Text: Share what your business does and what you want your website or tool to achieve. No tech jargon needed.
home.processStep2Text: We send a simple plan with a fixed price and timeline, so you can decide with confidence.
home.processStep3Text: We build in stages and show you progress along the way. Your feedback shapes the result.
home.processStep4Text: We launch, show you how everything works, and stay around for support when you need us.
home.ctaAccentText: Tell us a little about your business. Within 24 hours we'll reply with how we'd help, a price estimate, and a realistic timeline. It's free, with no obligation.
home.ctaTrust: You'll hear back from a real person, not a bot.
